correctness.rationale: The 12 facet normals give six antipodal normal axes; their six great circles are nontriple-concurrent, yielding 30 directed intersection rays. Every 6-bit sign mask is tested against these rays in exact Z[phi], giving precisely 32 nonempty chambers with side counts 10/20/2 for 6/8/10 projected vertices. Physical normal dot products yield four spherical-angle signatures (ABBPP,CCE,DDE,AAAAA); Girard excess gives stated exact masses, summing to one. Independent LP checked 64 patterns and found exactly 32, and 16000 direct convex-hull shadows corroborated distribution. Genericity excludes circle boundaries. Simulations are supplementary, not proofs.
